The company is expected to report a loss of $0.15 per share for the upcoming quarter, though this represents improvement from the prior year. Full-year earnings are forecasted at -$0.91 per share with revenue of $97.77 billion. The stock holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating, with analyst estimates declining 4.02% over the last 30 days.

headlines.title: Wall Street Analysts See General Dynamics (GD) as a Buy: Should You Invest?
headlines.summary: Wall Street analysts recommend General Dynamics (GD) as a Buy with an average brokerage recommendation of 2.00, with 54.2% of 24 recommendations being Strong Buy. However, the article cautions that brokerage recommendations often have positive bias due to institutional vested interests. General Dynamics received a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating based on earnings estimate revisions, with consensus estimates increasing 0.1% over the past month to $16.95 EPS.

headlines.title: General Dynamics (GD) Stock Falls Amid Market Uptick: What Investors Need to Know
headlines.summary: General Dynamics stock declined 1.13% to $355.95, underperforming the broader market's gains. The stock has dropped 8.24% over the past month. Despite this weakness, the company is expected to report EPS growth of 6.7% and revenue growth of 5.84% for the upcoming quarter, with full-year projections showing 9.64% earnings growth. The stock currently holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating with a Forward P/E of 21.16, trading at a discount to its industry average.

headlines.title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT Bernstein Liebhard LLP Announces A Securities Fraud Class Action Lawsuit Has Been Filed Against AST SpaceMobile, Inc. (ASTS)
headlines.summary: Bernstein Liebhard LLP has announced securities fraud class action lawsuits against three companies: AST SpaceMobile (ASTS) for investors who purchased shares between March 4, 2025 and July 15, 2026; Baidu (BIDU) for shareholders between November 18, 2025 and August 17, 2026; and Lincoln Educational Services (LINC) for shareholders between May 11, 2026 and August 9, 2026. The lawsuits allege materially false and misleading statements regarding business operations, growth prospects, and financial stability, resulting in artificially inflated stock prices and investor losses.

headlines.title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT Bernstein Liebhard LLP Announces A Securities Fraud Class Action Lawsuit Has Been Filed Against Baidu, Inc. (BIDU)
headlines.summary: Bernstein Liebhard LLP has filed securities fraud class action lawsuits against Baidu, Inc., AST SpaceMobile, Inc., and Lincoln Educational Services Corporation. The lawsuits allege that defendants made materially false and misleading statements regarding business operations, growth prospects, and financial stability, causing investors to suffer significant losses when the truth was disclosed.

headlines.title: Can Kratos' Manufacturing Expansion Support Affordable Defense Growth?
headlines.summary: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions is expanding its manufacturing infrastructure across multiple facilities to support growing defense demand. The company is relocating turbojet production to Michigan, establishing a turbofan facility in Oklahoma, and expanding unmanned aircraft and additive manufacturing capabilities. With projected earnings growth of 50.91% in 2026 and 37.06% in 2027, KTOS trades at a discount to industry peers with a forward P/S ratio of 4.3X versus 7.14X industry average.

headlines.title: Is Astronics Building a Broader Aerospace Growth Platform?
headlines.summary: Astronics (ATRO) is expanding beyond aerospace components into commercial aviation, defense, and business aviation. The company reported seat-motion sales more than doubled to $22.2 million in Q2, with expectations to double again in 2026. ATRO holds dominant market positions in in-seat power (90% share) and aircraft wireless access points (60-70% share), positioning it well for retrofit opportunities and fleet modernization trends.

headlines.title: 3 Alternative-Energy Stocks That Could Withstand Fed's Rate Hike
headlines.summary: Following the Federal Reserve's 25 basis point rate increase in September 2026, alternative energy companies face headwinds from higher financing costs. However, three companies—Montauk Renewables, Constellation Energy, and TXNM Energy—demonstrate strong fundamentals with solid interest coverage ratios and significant earnings growth projected for 2026, positioning them to weather the higher rate environment.

headlines.title: NextEra Energy (NEE) Gains But Lags Market: What You Should Know
headlines.summary: NextEra Energy (NEE) closed at $81.28 with a modest +1.13% daily gain but has underperformed over the past month, declining 6.45%. The company is projected to report earnings of $1.17 per share with 3.54% year-over-year growth and revenue of $9.19 billion (+15.4% YoY). However, NEE carries a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating with a Forward P/E of 20.21, trading at a premium to its industry average of 16.92.

headlines.title: Buy AI-Led EME, PWR and CAT for Long-Term to Gain From Recent Softness
headlines.summary: Three stocks from the heavy construction, engineering and machinery industries—EMCOR Group (EME), Quanta Services (PWR), and Caterpillar (CAT)—are recommended as long-term buys due to their exposure to the booming AI data center infrastructure market. All three stocks have rallied significantly year-to-date but recently declined, creating buying opportunities at discounts to their 52-week highs. Each company has strong order backlogs, positive earnings revisions, and solid short-term price upside potential of 26-42%.

headlines.title: Buy 3 Neuberger Funds With Diverse Investment Strategies
headlines.summary: Stock markets showed strong recovery with the Nasdaq positioned to close higher for the week and the S&P 500 following closely behind. The article highlights three Neuberger Berman mutual funds recommended for long-term investment, all with Zacks Rank #1 ratings and strong historical returns.

headlines.title: Lennar Q3 Earnings Miss Estimates on Housing Weakness, Revenues Lag
headlines.summary: Lennar Corporation reported disappointing Q3 fiscal 2026 results with adjusted EPS falling 38.5% to $1.23 and revenues declining 8.6% to $8.05B. Home deliveries fell 3.4% and average selling prices declined 2.9%, with incentives reaching 12%. The company cut its full-year fiscal 2026 delivery target to 80,000-81,000 homes from 82,000-83,000 due to continued interest-rate pressure and weaker market conditions.

headlines.title: Generac Signs Amazon Generator Deal With $2.4B of Initial Deliveries
headlines.summary: Generac Holdings has secured a major long-term supply agreement with Amazon to provide backup power generators for data centers, with initial deliveries totaling $2.4 billion expected in 2027-2028. The deal includes warrant provisions extending up to $8 billion in qualifying payments. Generac's data center backlog reached $1.6 billion as of July 2026, positioning the company to capitalize on accelerating AI and cloud computing infrastructure demand.

headlines.title: Vertiv's Product Revenue Accelerates: Can It Outpace APH & SMCI?
headlines.summary: Vertiv (VRT) reported strong Q2 2026 results with product revenue rising 22% to $2.65B, driven by surging demand for AI data-center infrastructure. The company is expanding capacity globally and investing in advanced thermal and power solutions. However, it faces increasing competition from Super Micro Computer and Amphenol, both expanding their AI infrastructure portfolios. VRT stock has surged 47.8% year-to-date but trades at a premium valuation with a P/B ratio of 19.37X.

headlines.title: Can BWX Technologies' Nuclear Manufacturing Expansion Support Growth?
headlines.summary: BWX Technologies is expanding its nuclear manufacturing capabilities through facility expansions in Ontario and investments in advanced reactor technologies, nuclear fuel, and additive manufacturing. The company reported 2025 revenue growth of 18.3% to $3.2 billion. BWXT trades at a discount to industry peers with a forward P/S ratio of 3.31X versus the industry average of 7.14X, and carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating with projected earnings growth of 18.45% for 2026.

headlines.title: Quality Management System (QMS) Software Market Surges to $20.43 billion at a CAGR 11.7% by 2031 | Report by MarketsandMarkets™
headlines.summary: The global Quality Management System (QMS) Software Market is projected to grow from USD 11.73 billion in 2026 to USD 20.43 billion by 2031, with a CAGR of 11.7%. Growth is driven by digital transformation, regulatory scrutiny, and adoption of cloud-native platforms offering real-time quality visibility. Asia Pacific is the fastest-growing region, while North America leads overall market share.

headlines.title: Is Nuveen ESG Mid-Cap Value ETF (NUMV) a Strong ETF Right Now?
headlines.summary: The article provides an analysis of the Nuveen ESG Mid-Cap Value ETF (NUMV), a smart beta ETF launched in 2016 with $442.53 million in assets. NUMV tracks the TIAA ESG USA Mid-Cap Value Index with a 0.31% expense ratio and has returned 11.92% year-to-date and 14.53% over the past year. The fund holds 89 companies with heaviest exposure to Financials (19.6%), Industrials, and Information Technology sectors. Alternative ESG ETFs like ESGV and ESGU are also mentioned as comparable options.

headlines.title: Zacks Industry Outlook Caterpillar, Komatsu and Terex
headlines.summary: The Manufacturing - Construction and Mining industry is positioned for growth driven by U.S. infrastructure spending, mining demand from energy transition, and digital innovation. The industry has outperformed the S&P 500 by 59.7% over the past year and currently trades at reasonable valuations. Three key stocks to watch are Caterpillar (Strong Buy with record backlog), Komatsu (Hold with focus on automation), and Terex (Hold post-merger diversification).

headlines.title: Lennar Q3 Earnings Miss Estimates on Housing Weakness, Revenues Lag
headlines.summary: Lennar Corporation reported disappointing Q3 fiscal 2026 results with adjusted EPS falling 38.5% to $1.23 and revenues declining 8.6% to $8.05B. Home deliveries fell 3.4% and average selling prices declined 2.9%, with incentives reaching 12%. The company cut its full-year fiscal 2026 delivery target to 80,000-81,000 homes from 82,000-83,000 due to continued interest-rate pressure and weaker market conditions.

headlines.summary: Generac Holdings has secured a major long-term supply agreement with Amazon to provide backup power generators for data centers, with initial deliveries totaling $2.4 billion expected in 2027-2028. headlines.title: Can CAT's Quarry Automation Expansion Create New Growth Opportunities?
headlines.summary: Caterpillar is expanding its autonomous hauling technology deployment to two additional Luck Stone quarry operations in Virginia, equipping Cat 775 truck fleets with autonomous systems. This expansion follows a successful pilot at Bull Run Quarry that hauled 3.5 million tons since November 2024. CAT's autonomous trucks have collectively hauled over 13 billion tons without reported injuries, positioning the company to capitalize on growing demand for automation, safety, and labor solutions in the quarry industry.

headlines.title: MWA or NDSN: Which Is the Better Value Stock Right Now?
headlines.summary: Mueller Water Products (MWA) and Nordson (NDSN) are compared as potential value stock investments. Both have a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating, but MWA emerges as the superior value option with a forward P/E of 14.44 versus NDSN's 26.14, a PEG ratio of 0.96 versus 2.01, and a Value grade of B compared to NDSN's F grade.

headlines.title: KeyCorp Raises 2026 Revenue Outlook: What's Driving It?
headlines.summary: KeyCorp raised its 2026 revenue guidance to 8% growth from 7-8%, driven by strong loan growth (4-5%), NII expansion (9-11%), and improved fee income guidance (6-7% adjusted). The Clearwater acquisition and robust investment banking activity support the outlook. NIM is expected to reach 3.00-3.05% by year-end. Peer banks PNC and Citizens Financial also project solid 2026 growth.

headlines.title: Can PNC's Record Capital Markets Pace Support Its Fee-Income Outlook?
headlines.summary: PNC Financial Services Group is experiencing strong momentum in its fee businesses, particularly capital markets, which saw revenues jump 65.9% year-over-year in H1 2026. Driven by robust M&A activity and advisory demand, PNC raised its 2026 non-interest income growth outlook to approximately 9% from 6%. The company's Harris Williams investment-banking unit is on track for a record year, supported by strategic acquisitions that expanded its capabilities.

headlines.title: Will Truist's Prime Auto Lending Exit Strengthen Its Profitability?
headlines.summary: Truist Financial is selling $5.5 billion in near-prime auto loans from its Regional Acceptance Corporation (RAC) subsidiary as new CEO Mike Lyons implements a strategic portfolio review. The transaction, expected to close in late Q3 or early Q4 2026, will improve Truist's credit profile, reduce non-performing loans by over 10 basis points, and generate approximately $945 million in CET1 capital. The bank plans to redeploy resources toward core banking, payments, cards, and mortgage products.

headlines.title: The PNC Financial Services Group, Inc (PNC) Could Be a Great Choice
headlines.summary: PNC Financial Services Group is highlighted as a strong dividend investment option with a 3.32% yield, significantly above industry average. The company has increased its annualized dividend by 21.2% year-over-year and maintains a sustainable 37% payout ratio. With solid earnings growth projected at 16.03% for 2026, PNC presents an attractive income investment opportunity, though it carries a Zacks Rank of #3 (Hold).

headlines.title: BAC Warns of Q3 Capital Markets Weakness: Will Fee Income Take a Hit?
headlines.summary: Bank of America expects Q3 investment banking fees of $1.6-$1.8B, down ~15% year-over-year, with trading revenues flat. However, wealth management AUM fees projected to rise 10-15% should offset some weakness. CEO Moynihan noted a 'very strong' deal pipeline, suggesting the slowdown may be timing-related rather than structural.

headlines.title: Can Centene Sustain Its Turnaround Amid Membership Pressure?
headlines.summary: Centene Corporation reported Q2 2026 adjusted EPS of $2.51, marking a significant recovery from a loss a year prior, driven by improved medical cost trends and better execution. The company expects Medicaid membership to decline 8%-9% in 2026, but profitability improvements in Marketplace and Medicare segments, combined with higher Medicaid rates and cost initiatives, support continued recovery. CNC reaffirmed its 2026 adjusted EPS guidance above $4.80.

headlines.title: BTSG Faces $200M IRA Hit but Efficiency May Protect Profitability
headlines.summary: BrightSpring Health Services' Home and Community Pharmacy segment experienced an 8% revenue decline to $540M in Q2, with the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) accounting for approximately $50M of the impact. Despite a projected $200M revenue headwind in 2026 from IRA pricing changes, the company expects only a $15M EBITDA impact, demonstrating that operational efficiency gains from technology, automation, AI, and Lean initiatives are offsetting regulatory pressures. Peer companies Cardinal Health and CVS Health are similarly navigating IRA-driven revenue pressures while maintaining profitability through service agreements and operational improvements.

headlines.title: Global Value-Based Healthcare Market is Predicted to Cross USD 60 Billion by 2034 | DelveInsight
headlines.summary: The value-based healthcare market is experiencing robust growth, projected to reach USD 62 billion by 2034 from USD 16.5 billion in 2025, with a CAGR of ~16%. The shift from fee-for-service to outcome-based payment models is driven by rising healthcare costs, chronic disease burden, and government reimbursement reforms. North America dominates with 72% market share, while Asia-Pacific is expected to record the fastest growth. Key players include Optum, Humana, Evolent Health, Agilon Health, and Privia Health.

headlines.title: CVS Health (CVS) Suffers a Larger Drop Than the General Market: Key Insights
headlines.summary: CVS Health closed down 1.17%, underperforming the S&P 500's 0.45% decline. Despite beating the Medical sector over the past month with a 1.64% gain, the company faces flat EPS projections for the upcoming quarter at $1.6, though full-year earnings are expected to grow 18.81%. CVS trades at a Forward P/E of 11.91, below its industry average, and holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating.

headlines.title: IQVIA Stock Rises 60% in 6 Months: Here's What You Should Know
headlines.summary: IQVIA (IQV) has surged 60.1% over six months, driven by 6% organic growth in Q2 2026, with R&DS bookings up 19.3% and a $34.2 billion backlog. The company's rapid AI adoption—294 agents deployed across 90 use cases with 19 of top 20 pharma companies adopting solutions—is strengthening its competitive position and supporting sustained growth.

headlines.title: Can CAH Navigate IRA Pricing Changes Risk Without Margin Pressure?
headlines.summary: Cardinal Health expects fiscal 2027 IRA pricing changes to create similar revenue headwinds as 2026, but management aims to preserve compensation and maintain profitability through distribution agreements and operational efficiency. Peers BrightSpring and CVS Health also face IRA-related revenue pressure but are offsetting impacts through operational improvements and specialty pharmacy growth.

headlines.title: Is Invesco S&P 500 Pure Value ETF (RPV) a Strong ETF Right Now?
headlines.summary: The Invesco S&P 500 Pure Value ETF (RPV) is a smart beta ETF with $1.75 billion in assets that tracks the S&P 500 Pure Value Index. It has delivered 19.31% year-to-date returns and 26.47% over the past year with a 0.35% expense ratio. The fund holds 125 stocks with heavy exposure to Financials (20.4%), Healthcare, and Consumer Staples sectors. While RPV offers reasonable value-focused exposure, cheaper alternatives like Vanguard's VTV (0.03% expense ratio) and Schwab's SCHD (0.06% expense ratio) may be more cost-effective for investors.

headlines.title: Here's How CVS' Health Services Arm Is Positioned for Long-Term Growth
headlines.summary: CVS Health's Health Services segment demonstrated strong Q2 2026 performance with revenues rising 11.5% to $51.8B and adjusted operating income climbing 10%. Health Care Delivery revenues jumped nearly 23% driven by Oak Street Health, while Pharmacy Services benefited from favorable drug mix and strong new sales of $6B. The company maintained its full-year 2026 outlook despite 340B program adjustments.

headlines.title: Lennar Q3 Earnings Miss Estimates on Housing Weakness, Revenues Lag
headlines.summary: Lennar Corporation reported disappointing Q3 fiscal 2026 results with adjusted EPS falling 38.5% to $1.23 and revenues declining 8.6% to $8.05B. Home deliveries fell 3.4% and average selling prices declined 2.9%, with incentives reaching 12%. The company cut its full-year fiscal 2026 delivery target to 80,000-81,000 homes from 82,000-83,000 due to continued interest-rate pressure and weaker market conditions.

headlines.title: Lennar (LEN) Reports Q3 Earnings: What Key Metrics Have to Say
headlines.summary: Lennar reported $8.05 billion in revenue for Q3 2026, down 8.7% year-over-year and missing consensus estimates by 3.44%. EPS of $1.23 fell short of the $1.29 estimate. Key operational metrics also disappointed, including lower home deliveries (20,840 vs. 21,439 estimated), fewer new orders (20,879 vs. 21,300), and reduced active communities. The stock carries a Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell) rating.

headlines.title: D.R. Horton (DHI) Falls More Steeply Than Broader Market: What Investors Need to Know
headlines.summary: D.R. Horton stock declined 1.34% in the latest trading session, underperforming the S&P 500's 0.45% loss. The homebuilder faces headwinds with projected full-year earnings down 9.68% and revenue down 4.2% year-over-year. The company holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating with consensus EPS estimates slightly revised downward by 0.06% over the past month.

headlines.title: Why Is Toll Brothers (TOL) Down 10.7% Since Last Earnings Report?
headlines.summary: Toll Brothers reported Q3 fiscal 2026 earnings and revenue beats driven by higher pricing, but both metrics declined year-over-year. Home deliveries fell 10% while average prices rose 2.3%. The company faces margin pressure from increased costs and SG&A expenses. Estimates have trended downward since the earnings report, and the stock received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating with an expected in-line return.

headlines.title: Mid-September Shakeup: Three Catalysts, One Afternoon
headlines.summary: Markets are pricing in a 93% probability of a 25 basis point rate hike by the Federal Reserve on Wednesday, marking the first increase since July 2023. The decision comes as inflation remains stubbornly above the Fed's 2% target. An unprecedented scenario could unfold if Chair Kevin Warsh opposes the hike while the committee votes to proceed—the first time in Fed history the FOMC would outvote a sitting chair. Key economic data on retail sales, housing starts, and building permits will provide context for the decision.

headlines.title: Zacks Investment Ideas feature highlights: Lennar  and Wayfair
headlines.summary: The Federal Reserve is expected to raise interest rates by 25 basis points on Wednesday for the first time since July 2023, with a 93% probability priced in by futures markets. This decision, combined with August retail sales data and Thursday's housing starts/permits report, creates significant market volatility. An unprecedented scenario could unfold if Chair Kevin Warsh opposes the hike while the committee votes to raise rates—the first time in Fed history a sitting chair could be outvoted on monetary policy. Homebuilder Lennar and online retailer Wayfair are key stocks to watch as they face headwinds from rising borrowing costs.

headlines.title: PulteGroup (PHM) Falls More Steeply Than Broader Market: What Investors Need to Know
headlines.summary: PulteGroup (PHM) declined 1.61% on September 16, 2026, underperforming the S&P 500's 0.45% loss. The homebuilder has fallen 5.22% over the past month, significantly trailing the broader market. Upcoming earnings on October 22 are expected to show declining performance with EPS projected at $2.63 (down 11.15% YoY) and revenue of $4.12 billion (down 6.4% YoY). The stock holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating with a Forward P/E of 11.86, trading at a discount to its industry average.

headlines.title: Toll Brothers Announces Grand Opening of Luxury Model Home at Enclave Community in Corona, California
headlines.summary: Toll Brothers announced the grand opening of its Dancy model home at Enclave by Toll Brothers in Corona, California on September 19, 2026. The exclusive 35-home community features single-family luxury homes priced from approximately $1.47 million, with 5-bedroom designs, gourmet kitchens, and modern amenities. The company continues expanding its luxury home portfolio across multiple markets.

headlines.title: Here's How Affirm's AI Upgrade Could Strengthen Credit Underwriting
headlines.summary: Affirm Holdings has launched a new transformer-based machine learning model for real-time credit underwriting at U.S. checkouts. The model approved more applications and generated 3.4% more completed purchases in testing by analyzing transaction and repayment patterns. The technology leverages 14 years of proprietary data to broaden customer access while managing credit risk, potentially supporting higher transaction volumes and revenues.

headlines.title: US Financial 15 Split Corp. Preferred Dividend Declared
headlines.summary: US Financial 15 Split Corp declared a monthly distribution of $0.07883 per Preferred share, maintaining a 10.00% annual yield. The fund invests in a portfolio of 15 major U.S. financial services companies including JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, Goldman Sachs, and others.

headlines.title: SEC Opens U.S. Door to Tokenized Stocks: Is Robinhood a Buy Now?
headlines.summary: The SEC's September 17 Innovation Exemption creates a five-year pathway for tokenized U.S. stocks to trade on blockchain-based venues, potentially benefiting Robinhood Markets. However, Robinhood must adapt its existing Stock Token infrastructure to meet SEC requirements for shareholder rights and voting privileges. While this presents a long-term growth opportunity, competitors like Coinbase and Intercontinental Exchange are advancing similar platforms, intensifying competition. The development is viewed as an incremental strategic positive rather than an immediate earnings catalyst.

headlines.title: BFH vs. FUTU: Which Stock Is the Better Value Option?
headlines.summary: A comparison of two Financial - Miscellaneous Services sector stocks reveals that Bread Financial Holdings (BFH) presents a better value opportunity than Futu Holdings Limited (FUTU). BFH has a stronger Zacks Rank of #1 (Strong Buy) versus FUTU's #2 (Buy), along with superior valuation metrics including a lower forward P/E ratio of 8.88 versus 11.50, a better PEG ratio of 0.67 versus 1.21, and a lower P/B ratio of 1.23 versus 3.08.

headlines.title: Can Worldpay Help Global Payments Build a Stronger Growth Story?
headlines.summary: Global Payments (GPN) has completed its Worldpay acquisition, becoming a pure-play commerce solutions provider. Q2 2026 results showed 33.8% revenue growth to $3.2 billion with normalized revenue growth of 4% and a 70 basis point margin improvement to 42%. The company projects 2026 normalized revenue growth of 4-5% and adjusted EPS of $13.60-$13.80, with successful integration and newer commerce offerings expected to drive future acceleration.

headlines.title: Paypal (PYPL) Registers a Bigger Fall Than the Market: Important Facts to Note
headlines.summary: PayPal stock fell 2.04% to $52.71, underperforming the S&P 500's 0.45% decline. The stock has lost 10.96% prior to this trading session. The company is expected to report Q3 earnings on October 27, 2026, with anticipated EPS of $1.32 (down 1.49% YoY) and revenue of $8.7 billion (up 3.38% YoY). PayPal holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) with a Forward P/E of 10, trading at a discount to its industry average of 12.91.

headlines.title: PayPal Debit Card Tops Javelin Strategy & Research’s 2026 General-Purpose Reloadable Card Scorecard
headlines.summary: Javelin Strategy & Research released its 2026 General-Purpose Reloadable Card Scorecard, identifying peer-to-peer linked cards as the new market leaders. PayPal Debit Card earned Best in Class honors, while Cash App Card and Wisely Direct were named Overall Leaders. The market is shifting toward integrated payment tools that combine low costs with added benefits, with GPR card load values expected to reach nearly $400 billion by 2029.

headlines.title: Wall Street Analysts See Visa (V) as a Buy: Should You Invest?
headlines.summary: The article primarily discusses the reliability of Wall Street analyst recommendations versus the Zacks Rank system. Using Visa as an example, it explains that brokerage firms show strong positive bias in their ratings due to vested interests, with a 5:1 ratio of Strong Buy to Strong Sell recommendations. The Zacks Rank, driven by earnings estimate revisions, is presented as a more reliable predictor of stock performance. Visa received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) despite having a Buy-equivalent average brokerage recommendation of 1.24.

headlines.title: The Zacks Analyst Blog Highlights Applied Materials, Philip Morris, Valero Energy, Crimson Wine and Global Self Storage
headlines.summary: Zacks equity research analysts featured five stocks in their daily blog on September 18, 2026. Applied Materials benefits from AI-driven semiconductor demand with an Outperform rating. Philip Morris shows strong pricing power and smoke-free product growth despite declining cigarette volumes. Valero Energy outperforms its industry with favorable refining dynamics. Crimson Wine faces headwinds from weak direct-to-consumer demand and distributor bankruptcy risks. Global Self Storage maintains focus on secondary markets but faces operating cost pressures.

headlines.title: Chord Energy's $550M Marcellus Exit Sharpens Its Williston Focus
headlines.summary: Chord Energy agreed to sell its entire Marcellus position to POSCO International for $550 million, with closing expected in Q4 2026. The divestiture will simplify operations, reduce net leverage by ~$25M in annual capital spending, and increase oil weighting by 4-5 percentage points. However, company-wide gas realizations are expected to decline 16-30% post-sale as the company focuses exclusively on its core Williston Basin assets.

headlines.title: Here's How Much You'd Have If You Invested $1000 in Marathon Petroleum a Decade Ago
headlines.summary: A $1,000 investment in Marathon Petroleum (MPC) made in September 2016 would be worth $9,673.54 as of September 18, 2026, representing an 867.35% gain. This significantly outperformed the S&P 500's 257.04% return over the same period. Analysts maintain an Outperform rating, citing the company's scale, integrated refining system, midstream operations through MPLX, and favorable refining margins.

headlines.title: WTI Crude Hovers Around $100: Are Oilfield Stocks a Smart Bet Now?
headlines.summary: With WTI crude hovering near $100 per barrel due to Middle East tensions, oilfield service companies are positioned to benefit from increased exploration and production activities. Baker Hughes and Oceaneering International are highlighted as potential beneficiaries, supported by strong subsea orders, improving regional activity, and longer contract durations.

headlines.title: Stock Market News for Sep 16, 2026
headlines.summary: Wall Street declined on Tuesday as rising Treasury yields and debt concerns weighed on investor sentiment, particularly affecting discretionary and utilities stocks. The Dow fell 0.6%, Nasdaq dropped 0.8%, and S&P 500 lost 0.5%. Energy stocks bucked the trend, gaining 2.3% as oil prices surged due to Saudi supply disruptions. Markets are pricing in a 94.5% likelihood of a Fed rate hike on Wednesday.

headlines.title: Valero Energy Corporation (VLO) Hit a 52 Week High, Can the Run Continue?
headlines.summary: Valero Energy (VLO) has surged 16.5% over the past month and hit a 52-week high of $407.27, gaining 147.7% year-to-date. The company has consistently beaten earnings estimates and maintains a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) with strong Growth and Momentum scores. However, valuation metrics show the stock trades at a premium on cash flow basis (18.7X vs peer average 11X), raising questions about sustainability of the rally.

headlines.title: Gas Turbine Market to Grow from USD 17.80 Billion in 2025 to USD 30.10 Billion by 2035 – Research by SNS Insider
headlines.summary: The global gas turbine market is projected to grow at a 5.40% CAGR from 2026 to 2035, driven by coal-to-gas power plant conversions, AI-driven data center demand, and adoption of hydrogen and ammonia-ready combustion technologies. North America leads with 29.50% market share, while Asia Pacific records the fastest growth at 8.30% CAGR. Data centers emerge as the fastest-growing sector with 11.20% CAGR.

headlines.title: Company News for Sep 16, 2026
headlines.summary: Several stocks showed significant movement following corporate announcements. Forgent Power Solutions jumped 9.5% after beating earnings estimates, while Skyworks Solutions surged 13.6% on optimism about a Qorvo merger closing by late September or October. Qorvo also gained 9.3%. However, Axon Enterprise slipped 9.8% following plans for a $1 billion debt issuance. Valero Energy rose 3.7% as crude oil prices climbed amid Middle East supply concerns.

headlines.title: The Zacks Analyst Blog Highlights Applied Materials, Philip Morris, Valero Energy, Crimson Wine and Global Self Storage
headlines.summary: Zacks equity research analysts featured five stocks in their daily blog on September 18, 2026. Applied Materials benefits from AI-driven semiconductor demand with an Outperform rating. Philip Morris shows strong pricing power and smoke-free product growth despite declining cigarette volumes. Valero Energy outperforms its industry with favorable refining dynamics. Crimson Wine faces headwinds from weak direct-to-consumer demand and distributor bankruptcy risks. Global Self Storage maintains focus on secondary markets but faces operating cost pressures.

headlines.title: J&J Up 18% in Three Months: Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock?
headlines.summary: Johnson & Johnson's stock has risen 18.3% in three months, driven by strong Innovative Medicine segment growth (6.2% organic), successful new drug launches (Icotyde, Imaavy, Inlexzo), and progress on talc litigation resolution. The company targets $100 billion in 2026 revenues and expects double-digit growth excluding Stelara impact. However, J&J faces headwinds from Stelara's patent expiration, MedTech slowdown, and upcoming generic competition for other drugs. Despite these challenges, analysts recommend staying invested given the company's diversified portfolio, strong pipeline, and confident guidance.

headlines.title: Can AstraZeneca's Broad Pipeline Offset Recent Setbacks?
headlines.summary: AstraZeneca's stock has declined following several late-stage pipeline failures including Wainua in ATTR-CM, Ultomiris in HSCT-TMA, volrustomig in NSCLC, and Etcamah in breast cancer. However, the company maintains a broad pipeline with over 20 expected high-value readouts in the next 18 months, particularly in oncology. The stock trades at a reasonable valuation of 16.29x forward earnings, below industry average, though 2026-2027 earnings estimates have been revised downward.

headlines.title: Sports Fan Analytics & Trends Study in the United States Examines U.S. Sports Fan Behavior Across 18 Sport Categories
headlines.summary: A comprehensive sports fan analytics study based on 6,666 U.S. consumers surveyed in January 2024 examines fandom trends across 18 sports categories, measuring viewership, attendance, social media engagement, sponsorship influence, and mobile consumption. The study identifies major brands and provides insights relevant to advertisers, sponsors, leagues, and media companies seeking to understand evolving fan behavior across streaming, mobile, and social channels.

headlines.title: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) Increases Yet Falls Behind Market: What Investors Need to Know
headlines.summary: Johnson & Johnson stock gained 1.1% to $270.22 but underperformed the S&P 500's 1.14% gain. The company is expected to report Q3 earnings on October 13, 2026, with projected EPS of $2.96 (up 5.71% YoY) and revenue of $25.36 billion (up 5.71% YoY). However, JNJ trades at a premium valuation with a Forward P/E of 23.05 versus the industry average of 15.67, and holds a Zacks Rank of #3 (Hold).

headlines.title: Non-Tech Stocks Can Still Deliver Huge Gains
headlines.summary: Consumer Staples stocks, particularly Coca-Cola, have demonstrated strong performance in 2026, gaining 26% compared to Meta's 3% gain. Coca-Cola's steady earnings growth of 9.7% in 2026 and 7% in 2027, combined with successful innovation in lower-sugar beverages, showcases how 'boring' but stable businesses can deliver consistent returns without the volatility of technology stocks.

headlines.title: Aduro parmi les 10 entreprises invitées à présenter leurs solutions au PepsiCo Sustainability Innovation Hub 2026
headlines.summary: Aduro Clean Technologies has been selected as one of 10 companies to present its Hydrochemolytic™ chemical recycling technology at PepsiCo's Sustainability Innovation Hub on September 23, 2026 in Mexico City. The presentation will focus on recycling polyolefin-rich flexible and multilayer plastic packaging, with support from ongoing work with ECOCE in Mexico. The company continues developing its technology at its pilot facility in Canada, with plans for a first-of-a-kind industrial facility in the Netherlands.

headlines.title: Aduro gehört zu den 10 Unternehmen, die eingeladen wurden, im Rahmen des „PepsiCo Sustainability Innovation Hub 2026“ eine Präsentation zu halten
headlines.summary: Aduro Clean Technologies has been selected as one of 10 companies to present at PepsiCo's Sustainability Innovation Hub on September 23, 2026 in Mexico City. The company will showcase its Hydrochemolytic™ technology for chemical recycling of polyolefin-rich flexible and multilayer plastic packaging, leveraging ongoing collaboration with ECOCE in Mexico. The presentation aims to demonstrate how HCT can address complex plastic waste streams that are difficult to process through conventional recycling methods.

headlines.title: Apptopia: NFL Season Drives Sportsbook App DAUs Past World Cup Peaks
headlines.summary: Apptopia published an updated report analyzing online sportsbooks and prediction markets, tracking daily active users, session frequency, and cross-app usage for major players including DraftKings, Flutter Entertainment, Caesars Entertainment, MGM Resorts, Kalshi, and Polymarket. The analysis covers the period from the World Cup through the first week of the NFL season.

headlines.title: LTH or ABNB: Which Is the Better Value Stock Right Now?
headlines.summary: Life Time Group Holdings (LTH) is positioned as a more attractive value investment compared to Airbnb (ABNB). LTH has a Zacks Rank of #2 (Buy) with a Value grade of B, featuring a forward P/E of 23.46 and P/B ratio of 2.76. ABNB has a Zacks Rank of #3 (Hold) with a Value grade of F, showing a forward P/E of 32.13 and P/B ratio of 12.86, indicating it is significantly more expensive on traditional valuation metrics.

headlines.title: American Airlines (AAL) Declines More Than Market: Some Information for Investors
headlines.summary: American Airlines stock declined 2.52% to $12.77, underperforming the S&P 500's 0.45% loss. The airline has depreciated 9.22% over the past month, significantly underperforming its sector. The company is forecasted to report negative EPS of -$0.32 with an 88.24% decline year-over-year, though revenue is expected to grow 17.77%. The Zacks Consensus EPS estimate has fallen 637.13% in the past month, and AAL holds a Zacks Rank of #3 (Hold). The Transportation-Airline industry ranks in the bottom 13% of all industries.

headlines.title: Royal Caribbean (RCL) Dips More Than Broader Market: What You Should Know
headlines.summary: Royal Caribbean stock declined 2.57% on September 15, 2026, underperforming the broader market. The cruise operator has fallen 15.39% over the past month, significantly worse than the S&P 500's 1.99% decline. Despite positive earnings expectations (10.43% EPS growth and 8.62% revenue growth), RCL holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating with a Forward P/E of 14.36, trading at a discount to its industry average.

headlines.title: Is It Worth Investing in Delta (DAL) Based on Wall Street's Bullish Views?
headlines.summary: While Wall Street analysts maintain a bullish average brokerage recommendation (ABR) of 1.16 for Delta Air Lines with 88% Strong Buy ratings, the article cautions that such recommendations often lack predictive value due to analyst bias. The Zacks Rank system, which relies on earnings estimate revisions, rates DAL as Rank #4 (Sell) due to a 4.7% decline in consensus earnings estimates over the past month, suggesting near-term downside risk despite Wall Street's optimism.

headlines.title: Best Buy's AI Push Drives Digital Growth & Retail Momentum
headlines.summary: Best Buy reported strong fiscal Q2 results with revenues up 3.6% year-over-year to $9.8 billion and comparable sales growth of 4.1%. The company is advancing its retail model through AI integration, experiential stores, and marketplace expansion. Computing sales led growth with a tenth consecutive quarter of positive comparable sales, while the Marketplace GMV forecast was raised to $1.3 billion. Best Buy stock has risen 26.5% over the past three months.

headlines.title: AutoZone (AZO) Q4 Earnings on the Horizon: Analysts' Insights on Key Performance Measures
headlines.summary: AutoZone is expected to report Q4 earnings of $54.97 per share, representing a 12.9% year-over-year increase, with revenues projected at $6.71 billion, up 7.5% from the prior year quarter. Analysts forecast domestic commercial sales of $1.95 billion (+10.6% YoY) and same-store sales growth of 3.7%, though this represents a slowdown from the prior year's 4.8%. The company is projected to expand its store count to 8,017 locations globally. However, AutoZone carries a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating and has underperformed the market, declining 7.4% over the past month compared to the S&P 500's -2.9% decline.

headlines.title: TJX Raises Fiscal 2027 Outlook as Q2 Results Show Broad-Based Growth
headlines.summary: TJX Companies raised its fiscal 2027 adjusted EPS guidance to $5.15-$5.20 following strong Q2 results that exceeded expectations. The company reported 11% earnings growth and 4% comparable sales growth, driven by higher merchandise margins and broad divisional gains. TJX also increased its long-term global store target by 500 locations to 7,500, planning 4% annual store growth from fiscal 2028. However, Marmaxx, the company's largest division, showed slower 1% comparable-sales growth, which management attributed to merchandise-mix issues.

headlines.title: TJX Falls 17.4% in the Past Month as Strong Results Meet Key Risks
headlines.summary: TJX Companies shares declined 17.4% in a month despite beating Q2 earnings expectations and raising fiscal 2027 guidance. While most divisions showed growth, Marmaxx comparable sales rose only 1%, below expectations due to merchandise mix issues. The company faces headwinds from higher wage and fuel costs, and its valuation premium leaves limited room for error.

headlines.title: Target Stock Up More Than 30% in 6 Months: Is It Too Late to Buy TGT?
headlines.summary: Target's stock has surged 34.4% over six months, significantly outperforming peers and the broader market, driven by improving business trends, stronger consumer engagement, and solid digital performance. The company raised fiscal 2026 net sales guidance to around 5% and adjusted EPS guidance to $9.90-$10.90. Trading at 15.86x forward earnings—below industry average but above its one-year median—Target receives a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating, with analysts suggesting existing investors hold while prospective investors gradually build positions.

headlines.title: JSAIY or WMT: Which Is the Better Value Stock Right Now?
headlines.summary: In a value comparison between J. Sainsbury PLC (JSAIY) and Walmart (WMT) in the retail supermarkets sector, JSAIY emerges as the superior value opportunity. JSAIY holds a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) with stronger earnings estimate revisions, while WMT has a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold). JSAIY's valuation metrics are significantly more attractive, featuring a forward P/E of 13.92 versus WMT's 37.63, a PEG ratio of 2.05 versus 4.12, and a P/B ratio of 1.25 versus 8.16, earning JSAIY a Value grade of A compared to WMT's D grade.

headlines.title: Should Investors Buy TJX as Growth Improves but Valuation Stays Rich?
headlines.summary: TJX Companies raised fiscal 2027 EPS guidance and targets 5%-6% sales growth with plans to expand stores to 7,500 locations. However, the stock trades at a premium valuation (P/S ratio of 2.06 vs. industry 1.58) that leaves little room for execution errors. Key risks include Marmaxx underperformance and rising cost pressures, though strong cash generation supports growth and shareholder returns.

headlines.title: DICK’S Sporting Goods, Inc. Securities Fraud Class Action Result of Undisclosed Inventory and Promotional Exposure and Over 30% Stock Decline - Investors may Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq., at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC
headlines.summary: DICK'S Sporting Goods faces a securities fraud class action lawsuit for failing to disclose material information about inventory and promotional exposure during the Class Period (September 8, 2025 - August 24, 2026). The company disclosed disappointing Q2 2026 results on August 25, 2026, with EPS of $3.53 (below $3.76 estimate) and Foot Locker revenue of $1.73 billion (below $1.81 billion estimate). The stock declined approximately 30% on this news. Investors have until November 3, 2026 to file lead plaintiff applications.

headlines.summary: Several stocks moved significantly in market trading: Coinbase Global gained 5.8% following new SEC tokenization rules, CoreWeave fell 4.2% after announcing a $3 billion convertible debt offering, SanDisk jumped 6.2% on broad tech rally strength, and Newmont Corporation rose 2.2% as precious metals benefited from falling yields and a weaker dollar.

headlines.title: SEC Opens U.S. Door to Tokenized Stocks: Is Robinhood a Buy Now?
headlines.summary: The SEC's September 17 Innovation Exemption creates a five-year pathway for tokenized U.S. stocks to trade on blockchain-based venues, potentially benefiting Robinhood Markets. However, Robinhood must adapt its existing Stock Token infrastructure to meet SEC requirements for shareholder rights and voting privileges. While this presents a long-term growth opportunity, competitors like Coinbase and Intercontinental Exchange are advancing similar platforms, intensifying competition. The development is viewed as an incremental strategic positive rather than an immediate earnings catalyst.

headlines.title: Will Sports Betting Hurdles Slow Robinhood's Prediction Markets Push?
headlines.summary: Robinhood faces regulatory headwinds in its fast-growing prediction markets business as Connecticut and Michigan impose restrictions on sports event contracts. Despite event contracts generating $156 million in Q2 2026—exceeding equities and crypto revenues—regulatory uncertainty from state enforcement and federal court rulings on unlicensed gambling could limit market access and growth. Competitors Interactive Brokers and Coinbase are also scaling prediction market offerings.

headlines.title: CoreWeave Boosts Agentic AI With Multi-Rack NVIDIA Vera Rubin Clusters
headlines.summary: CoreWeave is expanding its AI infrastructure capabilities by deploying multi-rack NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 clusters and introducing new storage features including cross-region write acceleration and a lower-cost Archive tier. These developments aim to support large-scale agentic AI workloads, though CoreWeave faces intensifying competition from Microsoft and Nebius Group in the AI cloud infrastructure market.

headlines.title: Bitdeer Announces August 2026 Production and Operations Update
headlines.summary: Bitdeer announced significant progress across its AI and Bitcoin mining operations in August 2026. The company secured 100% contracted GPU capacity for its 9.5 MW Malaysia A102 facility representing over $800 million in expected revenue, executed a 10-year agreement for an additional 65.1 MW at its A202 facility, and announced a 16-year lease for its Tydal, Norway data center worth $4.7 billion. Bitcoin production surged 249% year-over-year to 1,310 BTC, while AI Cloud ARR reached approximately $86 million.

headlines.title: Buy 3 Neuberger Funds With Diverse Investment Strategies
headlines.summary: Stock markets showed strong recovery with the Nasdaq positioned to close higher for the week and the S&P 500 following closely behind. The article highlights three Neuberger Berman mutual funds recommended for long-term investment, all with Zacks Rank #1 ratings and strong historical returns.

headlines.title: Snowflake's Product Revenue Accelerates: Can It Outpace DELL & ORCL?
headlines.summary: Snowflake reported strong fiscal Q2 product revenue growth of 37% to $1.49 billion, with AI products driving roughly half of the acceleration. The company raised fiscal 2027 product revenue guidance to $6.07 billion (36% YoY growth) and added 692 net new customers, bringing total customers to 14,554. Snowflake faces competition from Dell Technologies and Oracle, both expanding their AI capabilities, but maintains a strong position in enterprise data and AI markets.

headlines.title: ROP Benefits From Strength in Application Software Unit: Can the Momentum Sustain?
headlines.summary: Roper Technologies' Application Software segment, representing 56% of total revenues, grew 8% year-over-year to $1.18 billion in Q2 2026. Strong performance from Aderant, Deltek, Vertafore, and CentralReach businesses, driven by SaaS adoption and GenAI innovation, supports continued mid-single-digit organic growth expectations for the remainder of 2026.

headlines.title: Datadog (DDOG) Outpaces Stock Market Gains: What You Should Know
headlines.summary: Datadog (DDOG) rose 2.26% to $236.00, outperforming the S&P 500's 1.14% gain. The company is expected to report Q earnings of $0.64 per share (up 16.36% YoY) and revenue of $1.14 billion (up 28.88% YoY). However, the stock trades at a premium valuation with a Forward P/E of 91.22 versus the industry average of 20.36, and a PEG ratio of 6.25 compared to the Internet-Software industry average of 1.14. Datadog holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating.

headlines.title: Traction Rec Introduces Fresh, a New Era of Technology for Community Recreation, at YMCA General Assembly 2026
headlines.summary: Traction Rec unveiled Fresh, a new AI-powered platform designed to streamline program registration for community recreation organizations. The first product, Community Self Serve, allows families to find and register for programs through personalized recommendations rather than manual catalogue browsing, reducing front desk workload and improving registration completion rates.

headlines.title: AI Productivity Tools Market Expected to Hit $69.22 Billion by 2035 at a 19.50% CAGR | SNS Insider
headlines.summary: The global AI Productivity Tools Market is valued at $11.72 billion in 2025 and expected to reach $69.22 billion by 2035, growing at a 19.50% CAGR. North America leads with 36% market share, while Asia Pacific shows the fastest growth at 21.21% CAGR. Cloud-based deployment dominates at 65% share, with subscription models accounting for 55% of revenue. Key growth drivers include enterprise automation, data analytics, code generation tools, and RPA adoption across industries.

headlines.title: Snowflake vs. Adobe: Which Enterprise AI Stock Is a Better Buy?
headlines.summary: Snowflake is positioned as the stronger enterprise AI play with accelerating growth (37% product revenue YoY), robust customer expansion (32% net additions YoY), and strong AI adoption metrics. Adobe faces headwinds from slower near-term monetization and moderating RPO growth despite expanding its AI portfolio. Snowflake carries a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) while Adobe holds Rank #3 (Hold).

headlines.title: June AI Joins Salesforce AgentExchange
headlines.summary: June AI, an AI implementation company founded by former Salesforce Bonobo AI team members, has joined Salesforce's AgentExchange ecosystem. The partnership enables June to help Salesforce customers accelerate deployment and migration by using AI agents to understand customer environments, translate requirements into implementation plans, and assist with configuration, testing, and deployment while maintaining data governance and permissions.

headlines.title: IBM Software Growth Slows: Will Recurring Revenue Support Recovery?
headlines.summary: IBM's Software segment revenues grew 5% to $7.8 billion in Q2 2026, but organic growth was flat due to customers shifting spending toward infrastructure. However, Hybrid Cloud revenues grew 11% with OpenShift ARR reaching $2.2 billion, and the Data business surged 19%. Despite revenue headwinds, IBM expanded Software segment profit by 9% to $2.5 billion with margin expansion of 110 basis points.

The company raised fiscal 2027 product revenue guidance to $6.07 billion (36% YoY growth) and added 692 net new customers, bringing total customers to 14,554. Snowflake faces competition from Dell Technologies and Oracle, both expanding their AI capabilities, but maintains a strong position in enterprise data and AI markets.

headlines.summary: While Wall Street analysts show bullish sentiment toward NXP Semiconductors with an average brokerage recommendation of 1.85 (Strong Buy/Buy), the article cautions that brokerage recommendations often have a positive bias and may not reliably predict stock performance. The Zacks Rank system, which relies on earnings estimate revisions, rates NXP as a Hold (#3) due to unchanged consensus earnings estimates over the past month, suggesting the stock may perform in line with the broader market in the near term.

headlines.title: Lenovo, MemryX Partnership to Expand Sovereign Edge AI in Saudi Arabia
headlines.summary: Lenovo and MemryX have signed a memorandum of understanding to expand sovereign edge AI deployments across Saudi Arabia. The partnership combines MemryX's Cascade 100P AI accelerator with Lenovo's ThinkEdge SE455 V3 servers to process video and sensor data locally, reducing latency and cloud reliance. The initiative is expected to drive demand for Lenovo's edge servers, strengthen its sovereign AI infrastructure position, and create recurring lifecycle services opportunities, with potential for regional expansion across the Middle East.

headlines.title: Vertiv's Product Revenue Accelerates: Can It Outpace APH & SMCI?
headlines.summary: Vertiv (VRT) reported strong Q2 2026 results with product revenue rising 22% to $2.65B, driven by surging demand for AI data-center infrastructure. The company is expanding capacity globally and investing in advanced thermal and power solutions. However, it faces increasing competition from Super Micro Computer and Amphenol, both expanding their AI infrastructure portfolios. VRT stock has surged 47.8% year-to-date but trades at a premium valuation with a P/B ratio of 19.37X.

headlines.title: Corning Rides on Expanding Partner Base: Will it Boost Prospects?
headlines.summary: Corning Incorporated has significantly expanded its AI infrastructure business through multibillion-dollar agreements with Meta, Amazon, NVIDIA, and Verizon. The company will increase U.S. optical-connectivity capacity tenfold and expand fiber production by over 50% to support AI data center expansion. However, growth remains dependent on the pace of AI infrastructure investment and customer deployment timing.

headlines.title: MCHP's Analog AI Deal Gains Momentum: Can It Outpace NXPI & TXN?
headlines.summary: Microchip Technology's technology-licensing business is growing, with Q1 FY27 licensing revenues reaching $42.6M. Its Silicon Storage Technology subsidiary secured AnalogAI as a customer for memBrain SAGE IP, which enables ultra-low-power AI inference on edge devices. The deal expands MCHP's edge-AI exposure but faces intense competition from NXP and Texas Instruments in the growing edge-AI market.

Defense programs including the MQ-25A Stingray and T-7A Red Hawk progressed to production stages. Global Services generated $5.3 billion in Q2 revenue with a $33 billion backlog. Boeing trades at a valuation discount to industry peers with consensus estimates showing significant earnings growth for 2026-2027.

GE.title: GE Aerospace (GE) Advances While Market Declines: Some Information for Investors
GE.summary: GE Aerospace gained 1.91% to $312.90, outperforming a declining market. The company is projected to report earnings of $2.01 per share (up 21.08% YoY) with revenue of $12.66 billion (up 11.96% YoY). Full-year estimates call for $7.91 EPS and $50.56 billion revenue. However, GE trades at a premium valuation with a Forward P/E of 38.81 versus the industry average of 24.25, and holds a Zacks Rank of #3 (Hold).

GE.title: Can 3M Continue Its Strong Capital Returns to Shareholders?
GE.summary: 3M Company returned $3.8 billion to shareholders through dividends and buybacks in the first half of 2026, with $1.8 billion remaining under its repurchase authorization. The company expects adjusted operating cash flow of $5.8-$6.0 billion and free cash flow conversion above 100% for 2026, while raising its quarterly dividend by 6.8% in February 2026. Despite trading above industry valuation averages, 3M shares gained 3.6% over the past year compared to a 27.8% industry decline.

FUL.title: Stay Ahead of the Game With H. B. Fuller (FUL) Q3 Earnings: Wall Street's Insights on Key Metrics
FUL.summary: H. B. Fuller is expected to report Q3 earnings of $1.46 per share (up 15.9% YoY) with revenues forecasted at $940.38 million (up 5.4% YoY). However, consensus EPS estimates have been revised 1.9% lower over the past 30 days. The stock has underperformed the market, declining 14.8% over the past month compared to the S&P 500's -1.3% change, and carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating.

BMY.title: Autoimmune Disease Therapeutics Market Set for Growth Through 2034 as Biologics, Precision Medicine and Pipeline Innovation Reshape the Competitive Landscape
BMY.summary: The global autoimmune disease therapeutics market is projected to grow from USD 132.75 billion in 2025 to USD 254.60 billion by 2034, at a CAGR of 7.5%. Growth is driven by rising autoimmune disease diagnoses, increased adoption of biologics and targeted oral therapies, biosimilar expansion, and emerging cell and gene therapies. Biologics dominate with 66% market share, TNF inhibitors lead drug classes at 29%, and rheumatoid arthritis accounts for 34% of revenue. North America holds 44% regional share while Asia-Pacific is expected to grow fastest.

BMY.title: CAR T-Cell Therapy for Non-Hodgkin’s Lymphoma Market Set for Expansion Through 2036, Fueled by Treatment Innovation and Rising Patient Demand
BMY.summary: The CAR T-cell therapy market for non-Hodgkin's lymphoma is projected to grow at a 7% CAGR from 2026 to 2036, reaching from a 2025 valuation of $3.20 billion across seven major markets. Growth is driven by broader clinical adoption, new indications, earlier-line use, and innovation in autologous and allogeneic platforms. The U.S. dominates with $1.90 billion in 2025 market value, while diffuse large B-cell lymphoma represents the largest patient population with approximately 78,000 cases across the markets.

BMY.title: Immunotherapy Drugs Market 2026: Precision Medicine, Next-Generation Biologics and Expanding Cancer Indications Fuel Growth Opportunities
BMY.summary: The global immunotherapy drugs market is experiencing significant growth driven by advances in biotechnology, rising demand for targeted treatments, and expanding therapeutic applications across cancer, autoimmune, and inflammatory diseases. Key growth factors include increasing disease burden, robust drug pipelines, personalized medicine adoption, and combination therapy development. The Americas and Europe remain dominant markets, while Asia-Pacific is emerging as a high-growth region. Major pharmaceutical and biotech companies are increasing R&D investments and collaboration to accelerate innovation.

BMY.title: Should You Invest in the iShares U.S. Pharmaceuticals ETF (IHE)?
BMY.summary: The iShares U.S. Pharmaceuticals ETF (IHE) is a passively managed fund offering broad exposure to the Healthcare-Pharma sector with $1.63 billion in assets. It holds approximately 60 pharmaceutical companies with top holdings including Johnson & Johnson (22.21%), Eli Lilly, and Bristol Myers Squibb, and carries a Zacks ETF Rank of 3 (Hold).

CAH.title: BTSG Faces $200M IRA Hit but Efficiency May Protect Profitability
CAH.summary: BrightSpring Health Services' Home and Community Pharmacy segment experienced an 8% revenue decline to $540M in Q2, with the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) accounting for approximately $50M of the impact. Despite a projected $200M revenue headwind in 2026 from IRA pricing changes, the company expects only a $15M EBITDA impact, demonstrating that operational efficiency gains from technology, automation, AI, and Lean initiatives are offsetting regulatory pressures. Peer companies Cardinal Health and CVS Health are similarly navigating IRA-driven revenue pressures while maintaining profitability through service agreements and operational improvements.

CAH.title: Can CAH Navigate IRA Pricing Changes Risk Without Margin Pressure?
CAH.summary: Cardinal Health expects fiscal 2027 IRA pricing changes to create similar revenue headwinds as 2026, but management aims to preserve compensation and maintain profitability through distribution agreements and operational efficiency. The company targets $100 billion in 2026 revenues and expects double-digit growth excluding Stelara impact. However, J&J faces headwinds from Stelara's patent expiration, MedTech slowdown, and upcoming generic competition for other drugs. Despite these challenges, analysts recommend staying invested given the company's diversified portfolio, strong pipeline, and confident guidance.

NBIS.title: Can CoreWeave Turn Its $104.2B Backlog Into Sustained Growth?
NBIS.summary: CoreWeave ended Q2 2026 with a record $104.2B revenue backlog (up 246% YoY) driven by surging AI infrastructure demand, raising 2026 revenue guidance to $12.4-$13.2B. However, the company faces significant execution challenges including $9.4B in quarterly capex, rising interest expenses ($640M, expected to reach $860-940M in Q3), and intensifying competition from Microsoft and Nebius.

NBIS.title: CoreWeave Boosts Agentic AI With Multi-Rack NVIDIA Vera Rubin Clusters
NBIS.summary: CoreWeave is expanding its AI infrastructure capabilities by deploying multi-rack NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 clusters and introducing new storage features including cross-region write acceleration and a lower-cost Archive tier. These developments aim to support large-scale agentic AI workloads, though CoreWeave faces intensifying competition from Microsoft and Nebius Group in the AI cloud infrastructure market.

HOOD.title: SEC Opens U.S. Door to Tokenized Stocks: Is Robinhood a Buy Now?
HOOD.summary: The SEC's September 17 Innovation Exemption creates a five-year pathway for tokenized U.S. stocks to trade on blockchain-based venues, potentially benefiting Robinhood Markets. However, Robinhood must adapt its existing Stock Token infrastructure to meet SEC requirements for shareholder rights and voting privileges. While this presents a long-term growth opportunity, competitors like Coinbase and Intercontinental Exchange are advancing similar platforms, intensifying competition. The development is viewed as an incremental strategic positive rather than an immediate earnings catalyst.

HOOD.title: Robinhood Markets, Inc. (HOOD) Falls More Steeply Than Broader Market: What Investors Need to Know

AMJB.title: Is WisdomTree U.S. Total Dividend ETF (DTD) a Strong ETF Right Now?
AMJB.summary: The article provides an analysis of the WisdomTree U.S. Total Dividend ETF (DTD), a smart beta ETF offering broad exposure to large-cap value stocks. DTD has $1.63 billion in assets, a 0.28% expense ratio, and a 1.84% dividend yield. The fund has gained 13.53% year-to-date and 16.22% over the past year, with a beta of 0.76 indicating medium risk. Top holdings include Microsoft, Nvidia, and JPMorgan Chase. The article also mentions alternative dividend-focused ETFs like SCHD and VTV for comparison.

AMJB.title: Can PNC's Record Capital Markets Pace Support Its Fee-Income Outlook?
AMJB.summary: PNC Financial Services Group is experiencing strong momentum in its fee businesses, particularly capital markets, which saw revenues jump 65.9% year-over-year in H1 2026. Driven by robust M&A activity and advisory demand, PNC raised its 2026 non-interest income growth outlook to approximately 9% from 6%. The company's Harris Williams investment-banking unit is on track for a record year, supported by strategic acquisitions that expanded its capabilities.

AMJB.title: JPMorgan vs. Wells Fargo: Which Bank Stock Has More Upside Potential?
AMJB.summary: JPMorgan and Wells Fargo are compared as investment opportunities in the banking sector. JPMorgan benefits from its diversified business model, strong capital markets franchise, and superior near-term earnings growth (22.7% expected for 2026), trading at a premium valuation of 14.20X forward P/E. Wells Fargo has improved prospects following regulatory remediation and asset cap removal, showing balance sheet expansion and 15.5% earnings growth, but trades at a discount valuation of 11.59X forward P/E. Both stocks carry a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold), with JPMorgan favored for its broader franchise and earnings durability, while Wells Fargo offers valuation upside if execution continues.

AXP.title: American Express Looks Beyond Cards With New Business Savings Offering
AXP.summary: American Express launches a high-yield business savings account offering 2.95% APY with no minimum balance or fees, integrating it with existing business checking and card products. The company plans to add rewards deposit features and AI-powered payroll tools to create a comprehensive business finance platform. The move aims to deepen customer relationships and create an additional funding source through deposit growth.

AXP.title: Visa Finds Online Spending Gaining Ground Across Key Markets
AXP.summary: Visa reports that the 'couch economy'—home-centered spending on online shopping, streaming, food delivery, and subscriptions—has become a lasting consumer behavior trend. U.S. online and in-app payment volume reached 58% in 2026 from 48% in 2019. This shift benefits payment processors through increased digital transaction volumes and recurring spending, though Visa trades at a premium valuation of 25.18X forward P/E versus the industry average of 17.69X and carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold).

AXTI.title: Bull of the Day: AXT (AXTI)
AXTI.summary: AXT, a semiconductor substrate manufacturer, is positioned as a critical supplier for AI data-center optical interconnects, particularly in indium phosphide (InP) substrates. The company reported record Q2 2026 revenue of $47.6M (up 165% YoY) with 44.9% gross margins and a 170% EPS beat. With a >$100M backlog, planned capacity expansions to $35M quarterly by end-2026 and $65-70M by 2027/early 2028, and progression toward 6-inch wafers, AXT is transitioning from a cyclical substrate maker into a critical AI infrastructure supplier. However, risks include potential slowdown in AI optical spending, China export controls, and margin sustainability.

AXTI.title: AXT's Geographic Reach Expands: Can It Drive More Revenue Growth?
AXTI.summary: AXT, Inc. is diversifying its revenue streams beyond China, with Europe revenues surging 302.3% and other Asian markets showing strong growth in the first half of 2026. However, the company faces intensifying competition from Coherent and Lumentum in the indium phosphide (InP) substrate market as both rivals expand their optical connectivity capabilities. Despite premium valuation, AXT holds a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) with 2026 earnings expected at 86 cents per share.

JOBY.title: Joby Aviation Expands Autonomous Flight Reach With Cross-Country Tour

The aircraft has completed over 400 flights and 800 automated hours while participating in three U.S. military exercises. The tour aims to test diverse environments, strengthen government and industry partnerships, and advance autonomous aviation networks. However, regulatory approvals and broader market acceptance remain key challenges for large-scale commercial adoption.

The company opened a new 45,000-square-foot facility at Fort Worth Alliance Airport as a long-term operating base. After Wolfpack Research published a critical report on August 17, 2026, PREPA terminated the contract, causing Flotek's stock to plummet approximately 20% ($7.17 per share). The investigation focuses on whether Flotek and its executives concealed risks and provided accurate information to investors.

LINC.summary: Kirby McInerney LLP has filed a securities fraud class action lawsuit against Lincoln Educational Services Corporation on behalf of shareholders who purchased securities between May 11, 2026 and August 9, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Lincoln made false statements about its admissions process effectiveness and failed to disclose a significant drop in student starts relative to enrollment. The company's stock declined 24.93% on August 10, 2026 after reporting only 1% year-over-year student start growth despite 9% enrollment growth.
